title: "It's hectic": American psychic shares Ekurhuleni murders reading
excerpt: American psychic Kandis Starr’s remote viewing of the Ekurhuleni murders sparks fear and gratitude among South African women as she senses two perpetrators.
content:
• American psychic Kandis Starr posted a remote viewing session on YouTube in response to the murders of nine women in Ekurhuleni
  • Kandis, who previously looked into the Joslin Smith case, shared what she saw about the Ekurhuleni murders
  • South African women flooded her comments, saying life in the country felt frightening and thanking her for responding to their cries for help

American psychic Kandis Starr turned her camera on for South Africa on 17 September 2026. The content creator is known to South African audiences for her remote viewing session on the Joslin Smith case.

She posted a new YouTube video after women in the country reached out to her amid the Ekurhuleni murders after nine women were found deceased. Kandis opened the video by acknowledging her South African followers directly, saying they were her biggest supporters and that she could see their cry for help. She said:

"I know you guys all feel endangered at the moment, and I am here to make you hopefully feel better,"

During the session, Kandis described the energies she felt. The medium stressed her reading was for entertainment purposes only. During her reading, Kandis also sketched what she described as a road and a secluded structure, noting letters she could not fully make out. She was clear that none of her impressions was confirmed fact. Kandis admitted she was deeply unsettled and was in distress:

"I don't know how to help you ladies."

SAPS has confirmed only one person is currently in custody in connection with one of the cases, with another person of interest being investigated. Watch Kandis Starr's full remote viewing session here:

SA react to Kandis Starr's Ekurhuleni murders session

The comments section filled with South African women expressing fear and gratitude:

@merciaferreira2989 wrote:

"Hi Kandis, thanks for looking into this, I am from South Africa too, and living close to the area where all these ladies are found. It is sad and scary, yes. We have no info on who this could be, 1 or more... we are only told to be very careful and to be vigilant and notify friends and family if we do go out alone."

@kereshkasingh6919 said:

"We also love you, dearest Kandis. Thank you for all your sessions regarding our beautiful country, South Africa ❤🇿🇦 currently it's hectic; what's going on 😢 cry our beloved country."

@iammemcourt3114 wrote:

"Prayers to all women and girls in Sth Africa ❤ I hope these violent predatory redrumers are caught right now and are held fully responsible for the horrific crimes against these beautiful Sth African women."

@AdelleLCoetzer shared:

"Thank you, Kandis. Life in SA right now is just scary. We love you so much and thank you for always helping us x 🇿🇦"
